news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: ₹2.38 loss per share (vs ₹10.81 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: ₹2.38 loss per share (improved from ₹10.81 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹23.8m (up 152% from FY 2025). Net loss: ₹48.5m (loss narrowed 78% from FY 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 73 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Sfal Speciality Alloys Limited entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 70.61% stake in Nilachal Refractories Limited (BSE:502294) from a group of shareholders for approximately INR 290 million.
news.body:
Sfal Speciality Alloys Limited entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 70.61% stake in Nilachal Refractories Limited (BSE:502294) from a group of shareholders for approximately INR 290 million on March 11, 2026. A cash consideration valued at INR 20 per share will be paid by Sfal Speciality Alloys Limited. In an related transaction Sfal Speciality Alloys Limited proposed to acquire 29.39% stake in Nilachal Refractories Limited.

The transaction is subject to approval by the shareholders of Nilachal Refractories Limited, the Stock Exchanges have granted their in-principle approval to the delisting of Nilachal Refractories Limited

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹1.73 loss per share (vs ₹0.16 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹1.73 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.16 loss in 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹35.3m (loss widened ₹32.1m from 3Q 2025).
